02 The Experience

One Day in Venice

01
The Panels
Inside the Craft
Filmmaker panels with director Destin Daniel Cretton, DP Brett Pawlak, production designer Charlie Wood, editors Gina Sansom & Harry Yoon, and Ryan Meinerding, Head of Visual Development at Marvel Studios — the below-the-line team, on the record.
02
The Creator Panel
Creators, Moderated by the Director
Hosted by Naz Perez & Coy Jandreau, featuring Jen Markham, Yasin "YaseenThatGuy" Muhammad, Giovanni "EditedByGeo" Marks, and Angelo "AngelinkFilms" Barrière — with Destin Daniel Cretton himself flipping the format and moderating.
03
The Reveal
100+ Pieces of Concept Art & BTS
Suit, props, script notes, and over a hundred pieces of concept art and behind-the-scenes material — shown in the room, most of it never seen outside the production.
04
The Stunts
Live Stunt Demonstration
The film's own stunt team, performing practical work live — the doubles and performers behind the movie, closing out the day's program.
05
The Trailer
First Look, Room Only
An exclusive, embargoed first look at the trailer — screened once, for the people in the room, before anyone else in the world.
no photography — it was embargoed. that's the point.
06
The Street
Spider-Man Over Windward Circle
A costumed performer — movement artist "Modern Tarzan" — scaled the building at Windward Circle and worked the street for photo-ops, stopping pedestrian traffic all afternoon.
"Truly some NY sh*t in Venice!" — Pedestrian, Windward Circle
